name: Lomita City Council
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, April 03, 2018 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Mayor Pro Tem Sanchez
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
a.
Proclamation - April as Donate a Life Month
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-f, be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Joint Special Meeting of the Lomita City Council and the Railroad Museum Board Meeting of March 20, 2018 and the Regular Meeting of March 20, 2018
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item # 7b
c.
Approve the Demands and Payroll
ACTION: That the demands and payroll be received and filed.
Item #7c
d.
ORD NO. 797 - An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, amending Section 2-11.04 of the Lomita Municipal Code to allow dogs in City parks and on City property provided dogs are leashed at all times. (Second Reading)
ACTION: That said ordinance be adopted.
Item #7d
e.
Consideration of a Letter of Support for California Water Service's Palos Verdes Peninsula Water Reliability Project
ACTION: Direct the Mayor to sign the attached letter to California Water Service's District Manager, Dan Armendariz, supporting the Palos Verdes Peninsula Water Reliability Project.
Item #7e
f.
Consider adoption of a Resolution of Intent to Levy Annual Assessments for Landscape Maintenance District No. 1 for Fiscal Year 2018-2019
Res 2018-09 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, Declaring the Intent of the City Council to Levy and Collect Assessments within the Lomita Landscape Maintenance District No. 1 for the Fiscal Year commencing July 1, 2018 and ending June 30, 2019, and setting a public hearing date of May 15, 2018.
RES 2018-10 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, ordering the Interim Public Works Director to prepare and file the Engineer's Report for Lomita Landscape Maintenance District No, 1, in accordance with the Landscaping and Lighting Act of 1972, being Division 15, Part 2 of the Streets and Highways Code of the State of California, for the Fiscal Year commencing July 1, 2018 and ending June 30, 2019.
1.
Consider adoption of a Resolution of Intent to levy annual assessments for Landscape Maintenance District No. 1, and set a public hearing date of May 15, 2018; and
2.
Consider adoption of a Resolution directing the Interim Public Works Director to prepare the Engineer's report for Landscape Maintenance District No. 1.
Item #7f
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
8.
SCHEDULE A DATE AND TIME FOR THE FY 2018-2019 BUDGET WORKSHOP AND FY 2018-2019 BUDGET PUBLIC HEARING ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council:
1.
Select one of the following dates for the FY 2018-2019 Budget Workshop: Monday, May 14, 2018 at 4:30 p.m.
Wednesday, May 16, 2018 at 4:30 p.m.; and
2.
Schedule the FY 2018-2019 Budget Public Hearing on Tuesday, June 19, 2018 at 6:30 p.m.
Item #8
9.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council meeting be adjourned the regular meeting to be held on Tuesday, April 17, at 6:30 p.m., in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
